verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets users visually define alert rules that Grafana continuously evaluates and then automatically acts on, sending notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie and similar systems. Grafana Cloud adds automatic escalation of alerts to on-call responders. Community users confirm rules written against varied data sources (even SQL) and routed automatically. missing for 10: documented actions beyond notifications/escalation (e.g. automated remediation or arbitrary programmatic actions), detailed first-party docs on rule/routing configuration depth, event triggers other than metric/log threshold evaluation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Visually define alert rules for your most important metrics. Grafana will continuously evaluate and send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie.
create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to the people who are on call, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review
The alert can be written in SQL and, with Grafana 8, routed just like Prometheus alerts.
giving you the flexibility to combine your data and alert on your metrics and logs in new and unique ways
